tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search pages & databases by title. Returns curated rows { id, object, url, title, icon, lastEditedTime }. Params: query, filter?, sort?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

filter.description: Limit to 'page' (pages only) or 'data_source' (databases — note: Notion API 2025-09-03+ uses 'data_source', NOT 'database').

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

startCursor.description: Notion pagination cursor from previous response.nextCursor.

fields.description: Override default whitelist. Pass field names from the curated shape.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-page
tools.description: Retrieve a page. Returns curated { id, url, title, icon, cover, properties, createdTime, lastEditedTime, parentType, parentId, archived }. Params: pageId, fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion page object. Default false.

tools.name: get-page-markdown
tools.description: Retrieve a page's full content as markdown using the native Notion v5 endpoint. Replaces `get-page-content` (eliminated 2026-05). Pass `includeTranscript=true` to inline meeting_notes transcripts. Response: { markdown }.

includeTranscript.description: Inline transcripts of meeting_notes blocks. Default false.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: create-page
tools.description: Create a new page under a page (parentType='page') or database (parentType='database'). For database parents, the row is added to the first data source unless `dataSourceId` is provided. Returns curated { id, url, title, icon, cover, parentType, parentId, createdTime }. Not retryable (no idempotency key).

dataSourceId.description: For multi-source DBs, the specific data source UUID to insert under. Ignored when parentType=page.

title.description: Page title. For database pages ignored when `properties` is provided; defaults to "Untitled".

properties.description: Full Notion properties object for database pages (used as-is). Overrides `title` for the title column.

propertiesSimple.description: Agent-friendly flat map: `{ Status: 'Done', Tags: ['urgent'] }`. Schema is resolved automatically. parentType=database only. If both `properties` and `propertiesSimple` are passed, raw `properties` wins (with warning).

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned page.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion page object. Default false.

tools.name: update-page
tools.description: Update page properties and/or archive state. Returns the curated updated page { id, url, title, properties, icon, cover, archived, lastEditedTime }. Idempotent per-field — retries are safe.

properties.description: Notion properties object to update (depends on database schema). Used as-is.

propertiesSimple.description: Agent-friendly flat map: `{ Status: 'Done' }`. Schema is resolved automatically. Database rows only. If both `properties` and `propertiesSimple` are passed, raw `properties` wins.

archived.description: Move to trash (true) or restore (false). Sent as `in_trash` per API 2026-03-11. Optional.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned page.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion page object. Default false.

tools.name: update-page-markdown
tools.description: Edit a page using markdown ops. Modes: 'replace' (default — overwrites the whole body with `markdown`), 'append' (adds `markdown` at the end, optional `afterBlockId`), 'edit' (apply per-string edits via `edits: [{oldStr, newStr, replaceAll?}]`). Returns { pageId, mode }. `replace` is destructive — not retryable.

markdown.description: Markdown body for replace/append modes. Headings #/##/###/####, lists, code, callouts, tables supported.

afterBlockId.description: Append mode only — block UUID after which to insert. Default: end of page.

edits.description: Edit mode only — array of [{ oldStr, newStr, replaceAll? }] applied in order against the page's current markdown.

allowDeletingContent.description: Replace/edit modes — must be true to allow shrinking the page. Default true.

tools.name: set-page-icon
tools.description: Set a page's icon (emoji or external URL). Returns curated { id, url, title, icon, lastEditedTime }. Idempotent.

icon.description: Emoji character or image URL depending on iconType.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion page object. Default false.

tools.name: set-page-cover
tools.description: Set a page's cover image from an external URL. Returns curated { id, url, title, cover, lastEditedTime }. Idempotent.

coverUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the cover image.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion page object. Default false.

tools.name: duplicate-page
tools.description: Duplicate a page including icon/cover/properties/children blocks. Returns { sourcePage, duplicate } with curated shapes. Not retryable — creates new pages each call.

targetParentId.description: Target parent UUID. Default: same parent as source.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on both pages.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion objects. Default false.

tools.name: get-database
tools.description: Retrieve a database. Returns curated { id, url, title, description, icon, cover, schema, createdTime, lastEditedTime, parentType, parentId, archived }. Params: databaseId, fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion database object. Default false.

tools.name: query-database
tools.description: Query database rows with filter + sorts. Returns curated rows { id, url, title, icon, properties, lastEditedTime }. `properties` whitelist controls which columns travel (default: title only). Pass `dataSourceId` directly for multi-source DBs; otherwise the first data source is used. Filter accepts the standard Notion shape: { property, <type>: { <op>: <value> } } — single-value ops only (Notion v5 does NOT support equals_any). To match any of N values, compose with `or`: { or: [ { property: 'Status', status: { equals: 'Done' } }, { property: 'Status', status: { equals: 'In review' } } ] }. Params: databaseId | dataSourceId, filter?, sorts?, propertyNames?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

databaseId.description: Database UUID. The first data source under it is queried unless `dataSourceId` is set.

dataSourceId.description: Specific data source UUID to query. Use for multi-source DBs (wikis, linked DBs).

filter.description: Notion filter object. Compose multi-value via `or`/`and` arrays — Notion does not have equals_any.

propertyNames.description: Whitelist of property names to include in each row. Default: only the title. Pass ['*'] to include all.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on each row envelope.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion API response. Default false.

tools.name: create-database
tools.description: Create a new database as a child of a page. Returns curated { id, url, title, schema, icon, cover, createdTime, parentType, parentId }. Not retryable (no idempotency key).

properties.description: Notion schema. Ex: { Name: { title: {} }, Status: { select: { options: [...] } } }.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion database object. Default false.

tools.name: update-database-schema
tools.description: Add/modify/remove database columns and optionally rename. Schema mutations target the data source (Notion API 2025-09-03 split). Pass `dataSourceId` for multi-source DBs; otherwise the first one is used. Set a property value to `null` to remove it. Returns the curated updated database { id, schema, title, description, lastEditedTime }. Idempotent per-field.

dataSourceId.description: Specific data source UUID for multi-source DBs.

properties.description: Properties to add/modify. Set value to null to remove.

title.description: New title. Optional. Sent on the data source.

description.description: New description. Optional. Sent on the data source.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion database object. Default false.

tools.name: create-database-item
tools.description: Insert a new row (record) into a Notion database. Add to table, create table item, append database row. Pass `properties` as a flat agent-friendly map: `{ Title: "Spec", Status: "In review", Tags: ["urgent"], Assignee: ["<user-uuid>"], DueDate: "2026-05-06" }`. The handler resolves the schema and serialises each value into Notion's verbose shape automatically. Returns the curated created page. Multi-source DBs: pass `dataSourceId` to target a specific source.

dataSourceId.description: Specific data source UUID for multi-source DBs.

properties.description: Flat map of column name → simple value. Schema is resolved automatically.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned page.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion page object. Default false.

tools.name: update-database-item
tools.description: Update an existing row (record) in a Notion database. Update row, modify record, change relation, set assignee, mark as done. Pass `pageId` and `properties` as a flat agent-friendly map: `{ Status: "Done", Assignee: ["<uuid>"] }`. The handler resolves the schema from the parent database and serialises each value automatically. Pass `archived: true` to move to trash. Idempotent — safe to retry. For multi-source DBs the `databaseId` of the row is read off the page parent.

properties.description: Flat map of column name → simple value to update.

archived.description: Move to Notion trash (true) or restore (false). Sent as `in_trash`.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned page.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion page object. Default false.

tools.name: get-block
tools.description: Retrieve a block. Returns curated { id, type, plainText, hasChildren, checked, language, caption, url, createdTime, lastEditedTime }. Params: blockId, fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion block object. Default false.

tools.name: get-block-children
tools.description: DEPRECATED — prefer `get-page-content` (markdown) or `get-blocks` (paginated raw). Kept for back-compat: returns { textContent } as recursive markdown. Pass includeBlockIds=true to embed `<!-- block: id -->` comments before each top-level block.

includeBlockIds.description: Embed `<!-- block: id -->` comments in the markdown. Default false.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-blocks
tools.description: List direct children of a page/block with pagination. Returns curated { id, type, plainText, hasChildren, ... }. Use when you need block IDs + structure. For rendered markdown use `get-block-children` or `get-page-content`. Params: blockId, limit (1-100, def 25), cursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Blocks per page. Min 1, max 100, default 25.

cursor.description: Notion pagination cursor from a previous nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion block objects (trimmed to maxDepth=2, maxChars=10_000). Default false.

tools.name: append-blocks
tools.description: Append blocks as children of a page or block. Supports paragraph/heading_1..heading_4 (H4 added in v5.16) and paragraph blocks accept an `icon` for inline emoji/external/file icons. `position` chooses placement: { type: 'after_block', after_block: { id } } | { type: 'start' } | { type: 'end' (default) }. Returns curated { blocks, appendedCount, parentId }. Not retryable (no idempotency key — creates duplicates on retry).

blocks.description: Array of Notion block objects in the standard shape `{ object: 'block', type: 'paragraph'|'heading_1'|...|'heading_4', <type>: { rich_text: [...] } }`. heading_4 added in v5.16. paragraph `icon` (v5.16) ONLY works when the paragraph is a direct child of a tab block — appending icon under a regular page returns 'Cannot set icon on a paragraph block that is not a direct child of a tab block'. Other types: bulleted_list_item, numbered_list_item, to_do, toggle, quote, callout, code, divider, image, video, file, pdf, bookmark, embed, equation, link_to_page, table, table_row, meeting_notes, synced_block.

position.description: Optional placement. Default end. Shape: { type: 'after_block', after_block: { id } } | { type: 'start' } | { type: 'end' }.

fields.description: Override default whitelist per returned block.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion blocks. Default false.

tools.name: update-block
tools.description: Replace `oldText` with `newText` in a block's text. Reads the block, verifies `oldText` exists (exact match), then updates preserving annotations. Errors with 'Text not found in block. No changes made.' when oldText doesn't match. Returns the curated block { id, type, plainText, lastEditedTime }.

oldText.description: Exact text currently in the block that should be replaced.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion block. Default false.

tools.name: delete-block
tools.description: Delete (archive) a block. Returns the curated archived block { id, type, archived, lastEditedTime }. Idempotent — retries are safe.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion block. Default false.

tools.name: create-column-layout
tools.description: Create a column_list with N columns on a page. `columns` is an array of arrays of Notion block objects (one inner array per column). Not retryable.

pageId.description: Page UUID to append the column layout to.

columns.description: Array of arrays. Each inner array is the blocks for one column.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned column_list blocks.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion blocks. Default false.

tools.name: create-advanced-blocks
tools.description: Create an advanced block. Supported types: 'callout' (icon + colour), 'toggle' (children), 'synced_block', 'meeting_notes' (summary + transcript), 'paragraph' (with optional `icon` per v5.16). `content` must match the Notion shape for the given `blockType`. Not retryable.

content.description: Notion block body (rich_text, children, icon, ...). For 'paragraph' you may include an `icon: { type: 'emoji'|'external'|'file', ... }` (v5.16+).

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion blocks. Default false.

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: List workspace users. Returns curated rows { id, name, type, avatarUrl, email, bot }. Params: limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion response. Default false.

tools.name: get-user
tools.description: Retrieve a user by ID. Returns curated { id, name, type, avatarUrl, email, bot }. Params: userId, fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion user. Default false.

tools.name: get-me
tools.description: Return the bot user (this integration). Returns curated { id, name, type, avatarUrl, email, bot }. Params: fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion user. Default false.

tools.name: list-comments
tools.description: List comments on a page/block. Returns curated rows { id, pageId, parentBlockId, discussionId, authorId, plainText, createdTime }. Params: blockId, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion response. Default false.

tools.name: create-comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a page (pass pageId) or reply to a discussion (pass discussionId). Returns the curated comment { id, pageId, parentBlockId, authorId, plainText, createdTime }. Not retryable.

pageId.description: Page UUID. Mutually exclusive with discussionId.

discussionId.description: Discussion UUID to reply to. Mutually exclusive with pageId.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion comment. Default false.

tools.name: update-comment
tools.description: Edit an existing comment. Pass plain `text` for a simple string body, or `richText` for full Notion rich-text formatting. Returns the curated updated comment { id, plainText, lastEditedTime, ... }. Idempotent — safe to retry.

text.description: Plain text body. Mutually exclusive with richText.

richText.description: Notion rich text array. Mutually exclusive with text.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Notion comment object. Default false.

tools.name: delete-comment
tools.description: Delete a comment by id. Returns { id, deleted: true }. Destructive: a deleted comment cannot be recovered. Idempotent — re-deleting an already-deleted comment is a no-op from the agent perspective (Notion 404s, we coerce to deleted=true).

tools.name: upload-file
tools.description: Upload a file to Notion. Three-step lifecycle: create → send → complete (handled internally). Provide either `dataUrl` (base64 inline) or `filePath` (server-side path). Returns { fileUploadId, status, name, contentType }. The id can be embedded in subsequent block creates as { type: 'file_upload', file_upload: { id } }. Hard cap 20 MB.

dataUrl.description: Data URI scheme — exact format `data:<mime>;base64,<base64Payload>`. NOT a raw base64 string. Either this or filePath is required.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a server-side file. Either this or dataUrl is required.
